name: Side Plank Hip Dip
instructions: Lie on your side and prop yourself up on your forearm, with your elbow under your shoulder and your legs straight and stacked.
Lift your hips until your body is in a straight line from head to feet. This is the start position.
Lower your hips toward the floor under control until they almost touch.
Use your obliques to lift your hips back up to the straight line, or a little higher.
Do all the repetitions, then change sides.
